title: Surreal Eye of Alchemy
description: A massive stylized eye forms the base of a surreal desert landscape, with colorful iris patterns and a small red heart inside the pupil. Above it, a crowned blue-skinned figure in a red robe pours liquid from a flask into a bubbling cauldron on the sand, while a green-robed lantern bearer walks along a dune path under a stormy sky with lightning.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a giant stylized human eye embedded in desert sand as the foundation of the composition. The eye has a vibrant multicolored iris with purple, green and blue tones and a small red heart floating in the pupil. A blue-skinned alchemist wearing a golden crown and flowing red robe stands pouring blue liquid from a flask into a large cauldron that overflows onto the eye. In the background a figure in a green robe carries a lantern along a sandy dune path. Dramatic stormy sky with dark clouds, lightning bolts, a full moon, scales of justice, potion bottles, red roses, and a red rat on a branch.
